# Obour Academic Hub

> Obour Academic Hub is the official student learning portal and academic companion for Obour Higher Institutes in Egypt (Higher Institute for Engineering & Technology, and Higher Institute for Management & Information Systems).

## Core Academic Services
- Course Resources & Lectures: https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/subject
- Study Matchmaking & Sessions: https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/hagaz
- Past Examinations & Model Answers: https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/exams
- Interactive Q&A Forum: https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/qa
- Student Task & Study Planner: https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/todo
- AI Lecture Audio Transcription: https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/transcribe
- AI Concept Mind Maps: https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/mindmap
- AI Academic Quiz Engine: https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/quiz
- Community Leaderboard & Standing: https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/community/leaderboard
- Obour Hub VIP Membership (Egyptian Pounds): https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/plus

## Statutory & Legal Compliance
- Privacy Policy (Egyptian Law 151/2020 & GDPR): https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/privacy
- Terms of Service (Egyptian Law 175/2018): https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/terms
- Refund Policy (Egyptian Law 181/2018): https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/refunds
- Cookie Policy & Consent: https://obourinstitutes1.web.app/cookies
